features: Inputs: 16 BNC (AHD/analog) + 4 IP; up to 20 IP channels (up to 20 channels mixed analog + IP)
Analog input: 960H analog cameras and 720p/1080p/5MP AHD cameras; recording up to 5MP Lite (1280x1944)
IP recording bandwidth 16-80 Mbps (16 Mbps default, about +4 Mbps per disabled analog channel)

No analytics on coax inputs; Intelligent video analysis on IP channels (depending on IP camera model): perimeter intrusion detection (PID), line crossing detection (LCD), stationary object detection (SOD), pedestrian detection (PD), face detection, cross counting (CC), sound detection, camera tampering
Power consumption not recorded: urmet.de states 10.9 W (with HDD), the user manual and urmet.com state 18.3 W (13.8 W without HDD)
Ethernet speed not recorded: urmet.de states 10/100 Mbps, the user manual and urmet.com state 100/1000 Mbps
Dimensions and weight not recorded: datasheet product data (227 x 300 x 50 mm, 1.112 kg) conflicts with the spec table (300 x 53 x 227 mm, approx. 3 kg)
Named in Urmet S.p.A. NDAA Section 889 statement (main chipset), June 2023
